confirmed_official_spec_rules: Anchor modes: PR, PR_SEGMENT, DIRECT_COMMIT, USER_COMPOSITE. Only PR and DIRECT_COMMIT are auto-generated. Successful initial import + completed lookup NO_MATCH_OBSERVED + default-branch verified at start and end yields 1 DIRECT_COMMIT candidate per commit (multi-commit auto-clustering is out of MVP).

Import runs: UNKNOWN != no PR. Incomplete required PR association sets Import Run status to PARTIAL (never PARTIAL_SUCCESS) and promotes 0 Events; default Event search returns 0 even when observation records exist.

Lifecycle statuses: CANDIDATE, CONFIRMED, REJECTED, SUPERSEDED, STALE. Top-level active/search/metrics visibility (is_active_top_level) is modeled separately from lifecycle_status. Arbitrary ACTIVE, EXCLUDED, and DISSOLVED statuses are prohibited.

Split: Mixed-purpose PR stays 1 CANDIDATE with a review flag (0 auto-split). Explicit user split requires disjoint user-approved scopes (file_paths, diff_hunks, review_thread_ids, content_unit_ids); PR split yields PR_SEGMENT CANDIDATEs, DIRECT_COMMIT split preserves DIRECT_COMMIT, parent becomes SUPERSEDED, overlapping scopes are rejected.

Merge: Same workspace and same repository only across eligible PR, PR_SEGMENT, and DIRECT_COMMIT (PR + DIRECT_COMMIT mixed merge is allowed). Validates each member's Event version, preserves immutable snapshots, marks members SUPERSEDED (excluded from default lists/metrics), rolls up member-only search hits to parent USER_COMPOSITE once, and does not auto-inherit member Fact/Claim.

Dissolve: Requires active USER_COMPOSITE expected_version, reason, and idempotency_key. Composite new version becomes SUPERSEDED with composite_membership_status='REMOVED'. Members are re-evaluated to CANDIDATE/CONFIRMED/STALE from current Source and prior review state. Composite Fact, Claim, and Export become STALE and are never retroactively deleted or auto-transferred.

Event API error codes: EVENT_VERSION_CONFLICT, CROSS_WORKSPACE_MEMBER, CROSS_REPOSITORY_MEMBER, DUPLICATE_COMPOSITE_MEMBER, NESTED_COMPOSITE_NOT_ALLOWED, CANNOT_LINK_CONFLICT, MEMBER_NOT_ACTIVE, MEMBER_ALREADY_COMPOSED, PR_ASSOCIATION_INCOMPLETE. CANNOT_LINK is a relation semantic, not a catch-all wire error code.
B-003 (post-success automatic change discovery and post-success late association reclassification) is tagged POST_MVP and separated from incomplete PARTIAL retries.
Dataset remains DRAFT (approved_by: null; never frozen as golden by agent) and assumes no OD-007 physical database tables.

Exact diagnostic observation/non-eligible record status tokens if exposed on Snapshot Import APIs (EV-003, EV-004, EV-013).

Exact HTTP status codes (e.g., 409 vs 412 for EVENT_VERSION_CONFLICT, HTTP codes for NESTED_COMPOSITE_NOT_ALLOWED / MEMBER_NOT_ACTIVE / CROSS_REPOSITORY_MEMBER) and If-Match header usage (EV-014..EV-016).

EV-008: Whether a dedicated undo-split command exists in MVP.
EV-010: Direct detail GET response shape for a historical SUPERSEDED member Event ID.
EV-011: Whether a separate restore command or Composite-exclude cascade exists.
EV-012: Exact error code when dissolve targets a non-USER_COMPOSITE Event.

EV-013: Whether submitting non-Event IDs (CONTEXT_ONLY ticket / unpromoted UNKNOWN commit) fails at request validation/404 or reaches domain codes such as CANNOT_LINK_CONFLICT / PR_ASSOCIATION_INCOMPLETE.

matrix.observable_outcome: 1 merged PR with 2 associated commits emits 1 active PR CANDIDATE (anchor_mode='PR', lifecycle_status='CANDIDATE', is_active_top_level=true); associated commits attach as evidence without spawning DIRECT_COMMIT candidates.

matrix.scenario_area: Default-branch direct commit (completed lookup + NO_MATCH_OBSERVED + start/end branch verification)
matrix.observable_outcome: 1 default-branch commit verified at start/end of a SUCCESS initial import with COMPLETED lookup and NO_MATCH_OBSERVED emits 1 DIRECT_COMMIT CANDIDATE (1-per-commit confirmed; multi-commit auto-clustering out of MVP).

matrix.scenario_area: UNKNOWN PR association -> PARTIAL Import Run (0 Events promoted) & non-mergeability
matrix.observable_outcome: Incomplete PR association sets Import Run status='PARTIAL' (promotes_events=false), promotes 0 Events, returns 0 default Event search results (EV-003), and cannot be merged into USER_COMPOSITE (EV-013); separated from post-SUCCESS B-003 reclassification (EV-018).
Commit reachable only on a non-default branch emits 0 DIRECT_COMMIT candidates regardless of physical collection stage placement.

Issue/ticket attaches strictly as CONTEXT_ONLY on the PR CANDIDATE, never spawns a standalone Event, and cannot be merged as a USER_COMPOSITE member (ticket-keyword search ranking separated from membership).

matrix.scenario_area: Shared ticket never triggers automatic merge
matrix.observable_outcome: Two merged PRs referencing the same CONTEXT_ONLY ticket remain 2 separate standalone PR CANDIDATEs (total_countable_events=2, total_user_composite_events=0).

matrix.scenario_area: Prohibited auto multi-PR merge vs explicit user manual merge
matrix.observable_outcome: Multi-PR inputs never auto-merge (EV-006); explicit same-workspace/same-repo manual_merge produces 1 USER_COMPOSITE CANDIDATE with SUPERSEDED members and immutable snapshots (EV-009).

matrix.scenario_area: Mixed-purpose single merged PR (review flag + user-approved split)
matrix.observable_outcome: Mixed-purpose PR stays 1 PR CANDIDATE with mixed_purpose_hint_present=true and auto_split_count=0 (EV-007); explicit user split produces 2 disjoint-scope PR_SEGMENT CANDIDATEs and SUPERSEDED parent (EV-008).

matrix.scenario_area: User split curation command with disjoint evidence_scope
matrix.observable_outcome: Parent PR transitions to SUPERSEDED (v2, is_active_top_level=false); 2 PR_SEGMENT CANDIDATEs carry disjoint concrete file_paths/diff_hunks/review_thread_ids/content_unit_ids (total_countable_events=2).

matrix.scenario_area: User manual merge (same-workspace & same-repo eligible anchors -> single USER_COMPOSITE)
matrix.observable_outcome: Same-repo manual_merge checks per-Event member versions, preserves snapshots, marks members SUPERSEDED, and creates 1 USER_COMPOSITE (EV-009); same-workspace cross-repo merge fails with CROSS_REPOSITORY_MEMBER (EV-016).

matrix.scenario_area: USER_COMPOSITE single-count, member search roll-up, SUPERSEDED history & anti-nesting
matrix.observable_outcome: Subsumed members are SUPERSEDED and never double-counted; member-only search hit rolls up once to parent USER_COMPOSITE (EV-010); nesting is rejected with NESTED_COMPOSITE_NOT_ALLOWED (EV-014); dissolve marks Composite SUPERSEDED + REMOVED (EV-012).

matrix.scenario_area: User exclude curation command (REJECTED, Source preserved)
matrix.observable_outcome: User exclude transitions target Event to lifecycle_status='REJECTED' (is_active_top_level=false, version=2) without deleting Source provenance, leaving sibling CANDIDATE unaffected.

matrix.scenario_area: User dissolve (expected_version + reason + idempotency_key, SUPERSEDED + REMOVED, member re-evaluation, Fact/Claim/Export STALE)
matrix.observable_outcome: Dissolve transitions USER_COMPOSITE to SUPERSEDED (v2, composite_membership_status='REMOVED'), re-evaluates members by current Source & review state (CONFIRMED/CANDIDATE/STALE), and marks dependent FACT, CLAIM, and EXPORT as STALE without deletion or auto-transfer.

matrix.scenario_area: Non-Event ticket / UNKNOWN commit merge rejection (zero mutation, no catch-all CANNOT_LINK wire claim)
matrix.observable_outcome: Manual merge targeting a CONTEXT_ONLY ticket or unpromoted UNKNOWN commit from a separate PARTIAL run is REJECTED with state_mutated=false; exact wire error codes left UNCONFIRMED.

matrix.scenario_area: Official merge rejection codes (NESTED_COMPOSITE_NOT_ALLOWED, MEMBER_NOT_ACTIVE) & zero mutation
matrix.observable_outcome: Nesting USER_COMPOSITE root returns NESTED_COMPOSITE_NOT_ALLOWED; merging REJECTED Event returns MEMBER_NOT_ACTIVE; merging already-composed SUPERSEDED member causes zero mutation with multi-violation precedence left UNCONFIRMED.
Stale per-Event expected_version=1 against current version=2 returns REJECTED with EVENT_VERSION_CONFLICT and state_mutated=false (HTTP 409 vs 412 and If-Match unconfirmed).

Same-workspace cross-repo merge returns CROSS_REPOSITORY_MEMBER; cross-workspace merge separates internal_policy_code=CROSS_WORKSPACE_MEMBER from external HTTP exposure; cross-workspace exclude rejects without merge-only error; per-workspace API counts (2, 1) separated from internal fixture total (3).

matrix.scenario_area: Post-success automatic change discovery (B-003, unpersisted external observation)
matrix.observable_outcome: Tagged POST_MVP (B-003); post-SUCCESS external PR #1702 observation is recorded in unpersisted_external_observations (persisted_in_mvp=false, total_held_items=0) rather than held_items.

matrix.scenario_area: Post-success late PR association reclassification (B-003, separated from PARTIAL retry)
matrix.observable_outcome: Tagged POST_MVP (B-003); SUCCESS snapshot with completed NO_MATCH_OBSERVED emits DIRECT_COMMIT CANDIDATE ev_exp_018_1 while later PR #1805 association observation remains unpersisted_external_observations in MVP.
